title: Mathematical modelling of cellulase production and continuous production of enzymes under carbon-limited conditions by Trichoderma harzianum P49P11
author: Lucas Gelain
redistribution: PDF inspected locally; not bundled. No open-content license established for the complete thesis.

evidence.finding: Glycerol biomass uses dried pellet mass. Cellulose culture uses total dry mass and post-acid-treatment residue.

Biomass inferred by mass difference. Possible incomplete digestion at high cellulose discussed; source reports 28 +/- 3 g/L cellulose at 24 h for the 40 g/L condition. This isolated value is not a recovered time-course SD array.
5 and 40 g/L cellulose assays were tried in parameter estimation with poor fit, then used for extrapolation. Do not call these blind source validation.
MATLAB estimation example refers to the same three cellulose workbooks; no raw duplicate time-course arrays recovered.
